neighbours.label: the position just before a dimension count (the space or article before '2D'/'3D', 'two-dimensional') in text comparing dimensions
fire: A cube is to three dimensions what a square is in 2D, and a line is in 1D.
Squares tessellate the plane, so in 3D the analogous shape is a cube; in 2D it is the square.
Engineers often treat a thin sheet of fabric as a 2D material when computing stresses.
The retina receives only a 2D projection of the three-dimensional world.
The model reduces the 3D elasticity problem to a 2D problem by assuming plane stress.
Think of a sphere's surface as a curved 2D world for an ant that lives on it.
A shadow is a 2D image of a 3D object cast onto a flat wall.
Graphene is effectively a 2D crystal, one atom thick.
quiet: A cube has six faces, twelve edges and eight corners, and every face is a square.
Squares tessellate the plane, which is why kitchen tiles are usually square.
Engineers often treat a thin sheet of fabric as a membrane when computing stresses.
The retina receives light that has passed through the cornea and the lens.
The model reduces the elasticity problem to a simpler one by assuming plane stress.
Think of a sphere's surface as a curved world for an ant that lives on it.
A shadow is a dark shape cast by an object onto a flat wall.
Graphene is effectively a sheet of carbon, one atom thick.
